title: (When) Should a Software Factory be Lights-off? Benchmarking Code Review Agents on Bug Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.13668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the advances of coding agents, software developers are spending more time reviewing code than writing code. As human review velocity falls behind agentic code generation, it is tempting to build automated review agents towards a future of "lights-off" software factory with little to no human supervision. To assess the practicality of such a fully autonomous software factory, we construct CRBugBench, a new benchmark that evaluates whether review agents detect human-verified bugs. We build a data pipeline that mines bugs from repository history, and pair each bug with its introducing PR to form a review task. CRBugBench consists of 1,000 review tasks across 98 open-source GitHub repositories, and 800 additional tasks from proprietary industry repositories at one large company. translated_title: （何时）软件工厂应该实现“熄灯”运营？代码审查智能体在缺陷检测上的基准评测
translated_abstract: 随着编码智能体的不断进步，软件开发者花在代码审查上的时间已超过编写代码的时间。由于人类审查速度落后于智能体代码生成的速度，构建自动化审查代理、迈向几乎无需人工监督的“熄灯”软件工厂的愿景颇具吸引力。为了评估这种完全自主软件工厂的实用性，我们构建了CRBugBench，这是一个用于评估审查智能体能否检测出经人工验证缺陷的新基准。我们构建了一个从仓库历史中挖掘缺陷的数据流水线，并将每个缺陷与其引入该缺陷的PR配对，从而形成审查任务。CRBugBench包含来自98个开源GitHub仓库的1,000个审查任务，以及来自某大型公司专有行业仓库的800个额外任务。随后，我们利用该基准研究智能体的审查质量：我们发现最先进的审查智能体表现良好：最佳组合（使用copilot-cli的claude-opus-5）能够捕获71.9%的
tldr: 该论文提出了CRBugBench——首个包含1,000个开源任务和800个工业专有仓库任务的代码审查智能体缺陷检测基准，发现最先进的审查智能体（claude-opus-5结合copilot-cli）可捕获71.9%的人工验证缺陷，为评估“熄灯”式全自主软件工厂的可行性提供了系统化工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CRBugBench, a new benchmark with 1,000 open-source and 800 proprietary industrial review tasks for evaluating whether code review agents detect human-verified bugs, finding that the best SOTA agent (claude-opus-5 with copilot-cli) catches 71.9% of them, providing a systematic tool to assess the feasibility of "lights-off" fully autonomous software factories.
